app.name: CaseMap
app.tagline: Organize your story and documents into one clear package.
app.description: A private space to prepare your asylum or refugee protection claim, so a legal professional can review it with you.

landing.heading: A quiet, private place to gather what happened.
landing.sub: You write down what you remember, in your own words. You upload the papers you have. When you are ready, a legal professional you choose can review it with you.
landing.what_this_is_not_title: What this tool does not do
landing.not_1: It does not decide if you qualify for protection.
landing.not_2: It does not judge whether your story is believable.
landing.not_3: It does not submit anything to the government.
landing.not_4: It does not change or delete the papers you upload.
landing.step1_body: بكلماتك الخاصة. لا شيء إلزامي، ولا وقت محدد، ويمكنك التوقف والعودة في أي وقت.
landing.step2_body: صوّرها أو ارفعها. لا يتم تغيير ملفك الأصلي أبدًا — تُحفظ الملاحظات والنسخ إلى جانبه.
landing.step3_body: يراجعها معك مختص قانوني تختاره بنفسك. لا شيء يغادر هذه الأداة حتى تقرر ذلك.
landing.cta_body: يتم حفظ عملك أولًا بأول. يمكنك التوقف والعودة إليه.

recovery.heading: Save your recovery codes
recovery.lede: If you lose access to your email or phone, these codes let you get back in. Save them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
recovery.important: Write them on paper, or store them in a password manager on a different device. Do not keep the only copy on this phone.

recovery.regenerate_note: The previous codes will stop working.

cards.does_body: It helps you organize your story and documents so a lawyer can review them.
cards.cannot_body: It cannot tell you if your claim will succeed. It cannot judge whether your story sounds believable. It cannot give legal advice. Only a lawyer can do those things.
cards.control_body: You choose what to share. You can correct anything. Your original documents are never changed.

orientation.checks_intro: There are no wrong answers here. This is just to make sure the tool has been clear.
orientation.q1: Can this tool tell you if your claim will be approved?
orientation.q1_correct: That's right — it cannot. Only a lawyer or a decision-maker can say what will happen with your case.
orientation.q1_wrong: Not quite. This tool cannot tell you if your claim will be approved. Only a lawyer or a decision-maker can say what will happen with your case.
orientation.q2: Can this tool decide if your story sounds believable?
orientation.q2_correct: Correct — it does not judge your story. It only helps you organize it.
orientation.q2_wrong: It does not judge your story. It only helps you organize it. A person deciding your case will look at your whole story with your lawyer.
orientation.q3: Are your original documents ever changed by this tool?
orientation.q3_correct: Right — your originals are kept exactly as you uploaded them.
orientation.q3_wrong: Your original documents are never changed. What the tool reads from them is stored separately, so the originals stay exactly as you uploaded them.

consent.heading: Your choices about how the tool works
consent.lede: You can use the whole tool without turning any of these on. You can change these choices any time.
consent.manual_note: With everything off, the tool works as a private organizer: you write, you upload, you sort — nothing is sent to any AI service.
consent.ai_processing_title: Let the tool read your writing and documents to suggest a timeline and questions
consent.ai_processing_body: When on, the tool sends your text and documents to an AI service to suggest a timeline, a list of documents, and questions for your lawyer. Every suggestion has to be checked by you and by a legal professional before it is used.
consent.machine_translation_title: Let the tool translate your writing and documents for you
consent.machine_translation_body: When on, the tool can translate what you write or upload. Machine translation is not the same as a certified translation. A lawyer or certified translator will still need to check it for anything official.
consent.prompt_title: This step needs your permission first
consent.prompt_body: This part of the tool uses an AI service. It is off by default. You can turn it on now, or keep working manually.

consult.title: التحدث إلى محامٍ
consult.intro: احجز استشارة مع مختص قانوني. أنت تختار من ومتى.
consult.notice_no_case: الحجز لا يشارك ملفك. يرى المحامي الاسم الذي تختار تقديمه والموعد والموضوع القصير الذي تكتبه. إذا أردت أن يطّلع على ملفك، فأنت تشاركه بشكل منفصل من شاشة الخصوصية والمشاركة، ويمكنك التوقف في أي وقت.
consult.notice_advice: تُقدَّم المشورة القانونية في الاستشارة نفسها. لا شيء في CaseMap يُعد مشورة قانونية.
consult.none_available: لا يوجد محامون متاحون للحجز بعد.
consult.none_help: تعرض هذه القائمة فقط المختصين الذين تم التحقق من ترخيصهم.
consult.topic_help: اجعل هذا مختصرًا. لا تضع تفاصيل ملفك هنا — يمكنك التحدث عنها في الموعد.
consult.disc_no_case: هذا لا يمنح المحامي حق الاطلاع على ملفك.
consult.disc_not_advice: تُقدَّم المشورة في الموعد، وليس عبر CaseMap.
consult.disc_billing: أي أتعاب تُرتَّب مباشرة بينك وبين المحامي. CaseMap لا تتقاضى مدفوعات.
consult.disc_cancel: يمكنك الإلغاء في أي وقت من هذه الشاشة.
consult.booked: تم الحجز. يمكنك رؤيته ضمن مواعيدي.
consult.slot_taken: حجز شخص آخر هذا الوقت للتو. يرجى اختيار وقت آخر.
consult.bring_questions: اصطحب قائمة أسئلتك إلى هذا الموعد
consult.name_help: أنت تختار كيف تُنادى. يمكنك ترك هذا فارغًا.

pro_avail.title: أوقات الاستشارة المتاحة
pro_avail.intro: انشر الأوقات المتاحة لديك، واطّلع على من حجزها.
pro_avail.no_case_notice: يعرض الحجز الاسم الذي اختار الشخص تقديمه والموعد وموضوعًا قصيرًا. لا يمنحك ذلك حق الاطلاع على ملفه — يأتي ذلك بشكل منفصل عبر إذن مشاركة يتحكم فيه هو.
